French Police Tactics Scrutinized Amid Student Protests

French police tactics are facing scrutiny following injuries sustained by students during nationwide protests. Reports indicate at least one teenager suffered a broken jaw, drawing criticism of police conduct. The protests themselves are ongoing, with student demands described as clear.
